newsitem.title: USA: Aerosonic sues former CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Aerosonic sues former CEO, president.

text.p: Aerosonic Corp said on Thursday it has filed suit against its former chief executive officer and president, David Goldman, for alleged fraud and misappropriation of funds and breach of fiduciary duty, among other things.
J. Mervyn Nabors, Aerosonic's current chief executive officer and chairman, said the lawsuit follows a recent review conducted by its outside public accountants.
The suit was filed in Pinellas County Circuit Court in Clearwater, Fla., Aerosonic said.
Goldman, who was employed by Aerosonic from 1969 until February 1996, served as president and chief executive from June 1992 until mid 1995.
Goldman could not be reached for comment.
